title: Test: The Causal Boundary
summary: Check what you learned across the whole chapter.

questions.q: The section **The Question This Book Answers** develops one of the chapter's claims. Which one?
options: Moving from advisory prediction through software agency to physical embodiment removes elastic virtual time, transactional rollback, and batchable execution, so data, compute, evaluation, and deployment each acquire physical stakes.

A system is physical AI only when it has a learned statistical model, consequential physical feedback, and delegated authority at once; an independent deterministic veto does not remove delegated authority, while per-command human approval does.

The machine is ordered as Brain (learned proposers), Nervous System (buses, schedulers, permission path), Body (plant), Boundary (register writes and sensor captures), and World, with governance as a lifecycle envelope rather than a sixth level, so a failure is diagnosed by the level that failed.

Work delivered across the causal boundary has no checkpoint to restore, so recovery is a new constrained motion limited by torque, friction, and drive limits, and the permission path must confirm that a feasible recovery still exists before it admits an action.
